text: {"assertions":["A listener registered but never removed on teardown caused broken email layout in notifications/email/render.py.","The broken layout issue only appeared on the first request after a cold start.","The symptom was a table overflow in the plain text part of the email renderer.","The fix was implemented in PR #1676 (fix/broken-layout-1 branch) by removing the listener on teardown and adding a test assertion.","The issue can be reproduced by rendering the digest template with a long subject.","The covering test is in tests/notifications/test_render.py.","The fix reclaimed 15 GB of blob storage."]}
